compact-big.title: Realistic: compaction on, multi-KB tool results
compact-big.description: Stores built with compaction on (131,072-token window) and 4-64 KiB tool results, so the model sees a bounded window while the database keeps growing. Tardigrade has no equivalent stores; it is not in this chart.

big.title: Realistic: multi-KB tool results, no compaction
big.description: Every tool result 4 KiB, every 13th 16 KiB, every 97th 64 KiB; the whole history stays in the model context.
